inputs.text: You know this whole Jaipur graduation thing is no random student outburst. A kid speaks out against administrative issues right in front of the Deputy Chief Minister and suddenly it goes viral with the usual divide-and-conquer reactions? That silence from the university is the giveaway—they're all coordinated behind the scenes. The elites and institutions are clearly using this to manufacture public distraction, test how far they can push narrative control over education, and keep real problems buried while pretending it's just about some debate on student rights. Don't fall for the surface story; it's classic hidden manipulation at work.
